proof:
Source: Step 5 of the parent proof ((5a)–(5c)), with the bump f₀ chosen explicitly. The tangent-space limit of (5a)–(5b) is supplied by the sibling ind_ab_rescaled_tangent_limit.

Notation: Hⁿ := μHE[n] on ℝ^P; B̄_s(x) is the closed ball; ν := Hⁿ⌞M = (μHE[n]).restrict M.

1. The bump. Define f₀(z) := max(0, min(1, 2 − ‖z‖)).
- f₀ is continuous and 0 ≤ f₀ ≤ 1.
- f₀(z) = 1 whenever ‖z‖ ≤ 1, since then 2 − ‖z‖ ≥ 1.
- f₀(z) = 0 whenever ‖z‖ > 2, since then min(1, 2 − ‖z‖) < 0.
So f₀ vanishes outside B̄_2(0), which is compact (ℝ^P is finite-dimensional). Hence f₀ has compact support.

2. The limit. Apply the sibling ind_ab_rescaled_tangent_limit to (P, n, M, θ, x, Q, f₀), using the hypothesis HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x Q. It gives
  I(s) := (sⁿ)⁻¹ ∫_M θ(y)f₀(s⁻¹•(y − x)) dHⁿ(y) → L := θ(x)∫_Q f₀ dHⁿ ∈ ℝ as s → 0⁺.
Since L < L + 1, the set {t : t ≤ L + 1} is a neighbourhood of L. Hence I(s) ≤ L + 1 for all s in some set belonging to 𝓝[>] 0.

3. Setup. Let C := Real.toNNReal(L + 1), so that C, viewed in [0, ∞], equals ofReal(L + 1). Fix s > 0 with I(s) ≤ L + 1 and put g_s(y) := θ(y)f₀(s⁻¹•(y − x)). We show ∫⁻_{M∩B̄_s(x)} ofReal(θ) dHⁿ ≤ C·ofReal(sⁿ). Since such s form a set belonging to 𝓝[>] 0, this proves the theorem.

 (a) Support. If y ∉ B̄_{2s}(x), then ‖s⁻¹•(y − x)‖ = s⁻¹‖y − x‖ > 2, so f₀(s⁻¹•(y − x)) = 0 and g_s(y) = 0.

 (b) Integrability. B̄_{2s}(x) is compact, so θ is Hⁿ-integrable on M ∩ B̄_{2s}(x) by hypothesis. The factor y ↦ f₀(s⁻¹•(y − x)) is continuous, hence AE-strongly measurable, and bounded by 1 in absolute value. So g_s is Hⁿ-integrable on M ∩ B̄_{2s}(x) (an integrable function times a bounded measurable one: Integrable.mul_bdd). By (a), g_s vanishes on M ∖ B̄_{2s}(x). Since M is Hⁿ-null-measurable, g_s is Hⁿ-integrable on M (IntegrableOn.of_ae_sdiff_eq_zero).

 (c) Nonnegativity. M is null-measurable, so ν-a.e. y lies in M (ae_restrict_mem₀). For such y, θ(y) ≥ 0 and f₀ ≥ 0. Hence g_s ≥ 0 ν-a.e.

 (d) On the ball. If y ∈ B̄_s(x), then ‖s⁻¹•(y − x)‖ = s⁻¹‖y − x‖ ≤ 1, so f₀(s⁻¹•(y − x)) = 1 and g_s(y) = θ(y). The closed ball is measurable, so Hⁿ⌞B̄_s(x)-a.e. point lies in B̄_s(x) (ae_restrict_mem). Since Hⁿ⌞(M ∩ B̄_s(x)) ≤ Hⁿ⌞B̄_s(x), the same holds for Hⁿ⌞(M ∩ B̄_s(x)).

 (e) The chain.
  ∫⁻_{M∩B̄_s(x)} ofReal(θ) dHⁿ
  = ∫⁻_{M∩B̄_s(x)} ofReal(g_s) dHⁿ   [the integrands agree a.e., by (d)]
  ≤ ∫⁻_M ofReal(g_s) dHⁿ   [monotonicity in the set, since M ∩ B̄_s(x) ⊆ M]
  = ofReal(∫_M g_s dHⁿ)   [by (b), (c) and ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal]
  = ofReal(sⁿ·I(s))
  ≤ ofReal(sⁿ·(L + 1))   [I(s) ≤ L + 1, sⁿ > 0, and ofReal is monotone]
  = ofReal(sⁿ)·ofReal(L + 1)   [ENNReal.ofReal_mul, since sⁿ ≥ 0]
  = C·ofReal(sⁿ).
 The last two equalities hold even if L + 1 < 0, since then both sides are 0. ∎

Appendix (formalization aid; not part of the mathematical argument). The following script was kernel-checked in scratch against the frozen environment (Lean v4.35.0-rc3, Mathlib 25730c7c, `import GMT.Ch06.Submission`, inside `namespace GMT.Ch06` with the contract's `open`s) and depends only on propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound:

theorem Submission.ind_ab_weighted_ball_growth :
    ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (x : Eucl P) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P)), NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → (∀ y ∈ M, 0 ≤ θ y) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → IntegrableOn θ (M ∩ K) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x Q → ∃ C : ℝ≥0, ∀ᶠ s in 𝓝[>] (0 : ℝ), ∫⁻ y in M ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ y) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) ≤ C * ENNReal.ofReal (s ^ n) := by
  intro P n M θ x Q hM hθ hint hQ
  obtain ⟨f₀, hf₀⟩ : ∃ f₀ : Eucl P → ℝ, f₀ = fun z => max 0 (min 1 (2 - ‖z‖)) := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hf₀c : Continuous f₀ := by
    rw [hf₀]
    exact continuous_const.max (continuous_const.min (continuous_const.sub continuous_norm))
  have hf₀nn : ∀ z, 0 ≤ f₀ z := fun z => by rw [hf₀]; exact le_max_left _ _
  have hf₀le : ∀ z, f₀ z ≤ 1 := fun z => by
    rw [hf₀]; exact max_le zero_le_one (min_le_left _ _)
  have hf₀one : ∀ z : Eucl P, ‖z‖ ≤ 1 → f₀ z = 1 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hf₀]
    simp only
    rw [min_eq_left (by linarith), max_eq_right zero_le_one]
  have hf₀zero : ∀ z : Eucl P, 2 < ‖z‖ → f₀ z = 0 := by
    intro z hz
    rw [hf₀]
    simp only
    exact max_eq_left ((min_le_right _ _).trans (by linarith))
  have hf₀cs : HasCompactSupport f₀ := by
    refine HasCompactSupport.intro (isCompact_closedBall (0 : Eucl P) 2) (fun z hz => ?_)
    rw [mem_closedBall, dist_zero_right, not_le] at hz
    exact hf₀zero z hz
  have hlim := Submission.ind_ab_rescaled_tangent_limit P n M θ x Q f₀ hQ hf₀c hf₀cs
  obtain ⟨L, hL⟩ : ∃ L : ℝ, L = θ x * ∫ z in (Q : Set (Eucl P)), f₀ z ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) :=
    ⟨_, rfl⟩
  rw [← hL] at hlim
  have hev := hlim.eventually (ge_mem_nhds (lt_add_one L))
  refine ⟨Real.toNNReal (L + 1), ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hev, self_mem_nhdsWithin] with s hs hspos
  have hs0 : 0 < s := hspos
  have hgint : IntegrableOn (fun y => θ y * f₀ (s⁻¹ • (y - x))) M (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) := by
    have h1 : IntegrableOn (fun y => θ y * f₀ (s⁻¹ • (y - x))) (M ∩ closedBall x (2 * s))
        (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) := by
      refine Integrable.mul_bdd (c := 1) (hint _ (isCompact_closedBall x (2 * s))) ?_ ?_
      · exact (hf₀c.comp (by fun_prop : Continuous fun y : Eucl P => s⁻¹ • (y - x))).aestronglyMeasurable
      · exact Eventually.of_forall fun y => by
          rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (hf₀nn _)]; exact hf₀le _
    refine h1.of_ae_sdiff_eq_zero hM (Eventually.of_forall fun y hy => ?_)
    have hy2 : y ∉ closedBall x (2 * s) := fun h => hy.2 ⟨hy.1, h⟩
    rw [mem_closedBall, not_le, dist_eq_norm] at hy2
    have h2 : 2 < ‖s⁻¹ • (y - x)‖ := by
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hs0.le), lt_inv_mul_iff₀ hs0]
      linarith
    show θ y * f₀ (s⁻¹ • (y - x)) = 0
    rw [hf₀zero _ h2, mul_zero]
  have hgnn : 0 ≤ᵐ[(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M] fun y => θ y * f₀ (s⁻¹ • (y - x)) := by
    filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem₀ hM] with y hy
    exact mul_nonneg (hθ y hy) (hf₀nn _)
  have hball : ∀ᵐ y ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (M ∩ closedBall x s)),
      y ∈ closedBall x s :=
    ae_mono (Measure.restrict_mono inter_subset_right le_rfl)
      (ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_closedBall)
  calc ∫⁻ y in M ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ y) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))
      = ∫⁻ y in M ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ y * f₀ (s⁻¹ • (y - x)))
          ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) := by
        refine lintegral_congr_ae ?_
        filter_upwards [hball] with y hy
        rw [mem_closedBall, dist_eq_norm] at hy
        have h1 : ‖s⁻¹ • (y - x)‖ ≤ 1 := by
          rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.2 hs0.le), inv_mul_le_iff₀ hs0]
          linarith
        rw [hf₀one _ h1, mul_one]
    _ ≤ ∫⁻ y in M, ENNReal.ofReal (θ y * f₀ (s⁻¹ • (y - x))) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) :=
        lintegral_mono' (Measure.restrict_mono inter_subset_left le_rfl) le_rfl
    _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∫ y in M, θ y * f₀ (s⁻¹ • (y - x)) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) :=
        (ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hgint hgnn).symm
    _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (s ^ n * (L + 1)) := by
        apply ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal
        have hsn : 0 < s ^ n := pow_pos hs0 n
        have h3 := hs
        rw [inv_mul_le_iff₀ hsn] at h3
        exact h3
    _ = (Real.toNNReal (L + 1) : ℝ≥0∞) * ENNReal.ofReal (s ^ n) := by
        rw [ENNReal.ofReal_mul (pow_nonneg hs0.le n), mul_comm]
        rfl
key_steps: Bump f₀(z) = max(0, min(1, 2 − ‖z‖)): continuous, 0 ≤ f₀ ≤ 1, f₀ = 1 on B̄_1(0), f₀ = 0 off B̄_2(0), compact support.
Sibling ind_ab_rescaled_tangent_limit with f₀: I(s) = (sⁿ)⁻¹∫_M θ(y)f₀(s⁻¹(y − x)) dHⁿ → L = θ(x)∫_Q f₀, so eventually I(s) ≤ L + 1.
For such s > 0, g_s = θ·f₀(s⁻¹(· − x)) is integrable on M (integrable on M ∩ B̄_{2s}(x), zero outside) and ≥ 0 a.e. on M.
∫⁻_{M∩B̄_s(x)} ofReal θ = ∫⁻_{M∩B̄_s(x)} ofReal g_s ≤ ∫⁻_M ofReal g_s = ofReal(sⁿI(s)) ≤ ofReal(sⁿ)ofReal(L + 1) = C·ofReal(sⁿ), with C = toNNReal(L + 1).
